annotations.title: Submit Customer Feedback or Support Request

description: Submit a bug report, feature request, or support inquiry to the Asterism team when blocked or when a capability is missing. Ask for explicit user consent first and send only a concise summary without private document contents or secrets.

callId.description: Optional idempotency key reused when retrying the same feedback submission.

category.description: Type of inquiry: bug, feature_request, or support.

description.description: Concise problem or request summary (no private document contents or secrets).

locale.description: User language code such as ko, en, zh-CN.

name: asterism_submit_feedback
